DreamZ Events & Ideas: Two Decades of Crafting Unforgettable Weddings and World-Class Events

Mumbai, India, September 04, 2024 – With over two decades of excellence in the field of event management, DreamZ Events & Ideas has emerged as one of India's most trusted and innovative event planning companies. Established in 1995 and headquartered in Mumbai, DreamZ has consistently delivered magical experiences, specializing in bespoke weddings, high-profile corporate events, and large-scale brand activations. Their wide-ranging services include wedding planning, corporate events, artist management, brand promotions, exhibitions, outdoor events, and rural marketing.

A Legacy of Creating Dream Weddings.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hired Event24, and I must say – they are hands down the best event management company we’ve worked with! From the initial consultation to the final wrap-up, their team was professional, creative, and incredibly organized.

Our company hosted a mid-year corporate office event for over 150 employees, and Event24 handled everything flawlessly. They took care of all the logistics – from venue setup, decoration, lighting, sound systems, and catering – and delivered a seamless experience.

What really stood out was their attention to detail and ability to tailor the event to our company culture. Whether it was the customized branding, engaging activities, or interactive entertainment, Event24 made sure our office event was not just another gathering, but a memorable celebration.

If you’re looking for a corporate event planner or need reliable support for your next office party, team-building event, product launch, or employee appreciation day, I highly recommend Event24. Their experience in event management truly shows in their execution and professionalism.

We’ve already booked them for our end-of-year celebration!
